description:
[Game reference] Rust DLC and Item Store packs: what each unlocks in game, Twitch drops. `dlc`: each Steam DLC (`key`, `name`, `appid`, `store_url`, `items` it unlocks). `packs`: every Steam inventory
item (mostly Item Store packs) that unlocks game items - `itemdefid`, `name`, `desc`, `limited`, `url` (Steam item
store), `items`. `twitch`: every Twitch-drop Steam item in the files and the items it unlocks (most are skins and
unlock nothing new). With `item`: just that item's requirement (`kind` dlc / steam_item / twitch, or null when
anyone can craft it). Use item=<shortname> for 'what do I need to craft X'. Link https://rust.wiki/dlc.

item.description: One item: which DLC or Steam item unlocks it (shortname).
